h1.en: concrete pump rubber spring φ260 restated in the order of Hydraulics

directAnswer.en: concrete pump rubber spring φ260 is restated below in Hebei Pinjin Machinery’s own catalogue words. The section order is the order of Hydraulics, and that page is not a second nameplate. The φ260 spring is one piece-row on the Xingtai rubber-spring page. Printed materials for this row: rubber and polyurethane. It is a damping spring for a concrete-pump piston, not the piston itself.
directAnswer.zh: concrete pump rubber spring φ260下面用河北品锦机械目录里已经有的说法重述。章节次序来自《液压技术》，那一页不是第二块铭牌。 φ260 弹簧是邢台橡胶弹簧页上的一行，按个。这一行印出的材料：橡胶和聚氨酯。它是混凝土泵活塞用的缓冲弹簧，不是活塞本身。

body.en: Where the source outline says “Overview”, the catalogue fragment below is the fragment a buyer is allowed to copy. The page lists φ150, φ180, φ200, φ230, φ235 and φ260. Rubber rows are φ150, φ180, φ200, φ230 and φ260. Polyurethane rows are φ200, φ230, φ235 and φ260. This φ260 row is rubber and polyurethane. Unit: piece. Hardness and service life are missing. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. A split or integral piston at φ260, where that size exists, is a different product page and a different unit. φ235 is on the spring page only. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write rubber spring or polyurethane spring, φ260, and the quantity in pieces, matching the material row above. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: 来源大纲写到“概述”时，下面这句才是买方可以照抄的目录原文。 页面列出 φ150、φ180、φ200、φ230、φ235、φ260。橡胶行是 φ150、φ180、φ200、φ230、φ260。聚氨酯行是 φ200、φ230、φ235、φ260。φ260 这一行是橡胶和聚氨酯。单位：个。硬度和寿命缺失。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 若分体或整体活塞也有 φ260，那是另一张产品页，单位也不同。φ235 只在弹簧页上。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 按上面的材料行写橡胶弹簧或聚氨酯弹簧、φ260 和个数。 没有印出的格子保持不印。

The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.

body.en: The source page divides this subject at “Hydraulic models”. The words under that heading, in this note, stay inside the Xingtai wording already printed. The page calls them Xingtai replacement wear parts, not OEM parts of other pump brands. Email or WhatsApp Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, and name the 橡胶弹簧 page plus this size and the quantity. The outline does not complete a blank. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulics
